preservation_notice: Artifact hashes identify exact retained source HTML/JSON, official PDFs, local PDF renders or returned web output as individually labeled. PDF visual verification is limited to listed selected pages; SEC S-4 printed labels were inspected in HTML, not PDF images. Full sources remain outside this addition. counting_rules: All nineteen rows excluded from historical receipt totals.
TAE-T01 and TAE-T02 describe the same advance.
Capacity, accrued unpaid interest and compensation are different categories; no grand total.
A reported bonus does not identify the bank source of the payment.
TAE-T06 GBP5.6m and TAE-T07 rounded USD7.5m describe one UKAEA equity investment; never sum them or the aggregate USD7.475m noncontrolling-interest cash-flow presentation.
TAE-T08 USD47.9m principally intangible/IP contribution or commitment is separate from cash, and nominal capital is not another cash receipt.
SH01 cash consideration is not by itself bank cash; no particular statutory mechanism or legal fault is inferred.
TAE-T09 and TAE-T13 are balances including restricted cash, not receipts; TAE-T10-T12 net flows reconcile them.
TAE-T14 asset sales overlap TAE-T11 investing net flow; TAE-T01 is already the advance; no settlement/date/account matching.
TAE-T18 is TAE-T15 plus TAE-T16 minus TAE-T17; gross equity, note face, fee offsets and net package overlap.
Unexplained100USD difference in Q3 cash offering costs is retained mechanically in annual-minus-nine-month arithmetic, not classified as fresh proceeds.
TAE-T19 is cash paid by TMTG for CRO; share and crypto consideration are not incoming cash.
The 75-row counterparty crosswalk has 74 named underlying entries and one unnamed aggregate; all are excluded from historical receipt totals and are not added to transactions.csv.
Fort Baker reporting row is split into two named funds without retaining an additive manager row; One Fin table adviser and underlying fund are separate fields.

55,857,181 PIPE shares and 27,514,652 named note-conversion shares are footnote-disclosed; unnamed 1,285,348-share note classification is an arithmetic inference, with instrument-specific disclosed fields blank.

Investor dollar fields are calculated contractual consideration or note face-equivalents, not bank payments or allocations of net cash; underlying fund capital origin and current holdings are unresolved.
Annual dollar amounts are displayed in thousands to one decimal ($100 precision); sub-$100 calculated residuals are not settlement discrepancy evidence.
Reported manager/control relationships do not establish ownership of underlying fund capital; note consent is not common-stock voting or board control.

Six million contingent M&A compensation shares have no USD value assigned; explicit payment trigger unmet as of June 30,2026 and later issuance not established. They are not added to PIPE allocations, cash receipts or TAE funding.
The post-closing placement right of first refusal is distinct from both fee-tail branches after engagement termination; no earned fee or completed future financing is recorded.
Dated FINRA corporate-control disclosure and historical S-4 renaming do not collapse YA II PN, its manager and the broker-dealer or allocate compensation to individuals.
TAE-T20 is the reported October 7 USD100m second tranche; TAE-T03 is its earlier capacity, not another payment. All twenty observations remain excluded from historical receipt totals.
